name: ai-bridge-vscode
description: Drive a logged-in web chat AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or your own) from inside VS Code. No API keys: the extension talks to the browser tab you are already signed in to.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Batch 0.1 only starts the loopback bridge and logs the handshake. No repository reads or writes happen until batch 1.2 adds the Workspace Trust gate, at which point agents are disabled in untrusted workspaces.

commands.title: AI Bridge: Inject Boot into a Fresh Chat
AI Bridge: Run T2 Summariser Now
AI Bridge: Suggest Code at Cursor

aiBridge.bridge.port.markdownDescription: Loopback port for the local bridge. Bound to `127.0.0.1` only. The remaining §4 settings groups (router, compressor, state, repo, performance) arrive with the Settings panel in batch 4.1.

aiBridge.bridge.autostart.description: Start the bridge process automatically when the extension activates.

aiBridge.logLevel.description: Verbosity of the bridge process log piped into the AI Bridge output channel.

aiBridge.browser.ports.markdownDescription: CDP debugging ports to probe, in order. The bridge **attaches** with `connectOverCDP` and never launches a browser — start Chrome/Edge yourself with `--remote-debugging-port=9222`.

aiBridge.browser.autoAttach.description: Attach to the browser automatically after the handshake succeeds.

aiBridge.ramCap.browser.description: Browser RAM cap in MB (spec §2: ≤ 500). Measured as the resident set of the attached browser's whole process tree.

aiBridge.ramCap.extension.description: Extension host RAM cap in MB (spec §2: ≤ 1 GB). Shown in the status bar tooltip.

aiBridge.watchdog.pollMs.description: RAM poll interval in ms (spec §5.11: 3 s).

aiBridge.adapter.id.description: Adapter used by the chat panel. Claude and Gemini join this list in batch 6.1.

aiBridge.chat.debounceMs.description: Quiet period before a response counts as settled (spec §5.4: 600–1500 ms). The copy-button sentinel usually ends the wait sooner.

aiBridge.chat.timeoutMs.description: Hard timeout for one answer. On timeout the partial text is kept.

aiBridge.repo.context.description: Attach repo context (signatures + bodies within a token budget) to every prompt.

aiBridge.repo.edits.description: Parse edit blocks out of answers and offer them as a reviewable diff. Nothing is written until you accept.

aiBridge.state.location.description: Where `state.full.json.gz` lives. `workspace` writes into `.ai-bridge/state` with a generated `.gitignore`; `global` keeps it under the home directory.

aiBridge.state.encrypt.description: Encrypt state with AES-256-GCM using a key held in SecretStorage. Off writes `state.full.json.gz`; on writes `state.full.json.gz.aes`.

aiBridge.state.maxSnapshots.description: Snapshots kept before the oldest are pruned.

aiBridge.state.snapshotEvery.description: Take a snapshot every N turns (0 disables the interval; init and manual snapshots still happen).

aiBridge.state.autostart.description: Start the state layer when the extension activates.

aiBridge.t2.backend.markdownDescription: T2 summariser (§5.5). `auto` probes Ollama on `t2.url`, then falls back to the offline heuristic extractor. `tab` uses a throwaway browser tab.

aiBridge.t2.every.description: Run T2 every N turns (spec §5.5: every 5). 0 disables the interval.

aiBridge.compressor.enabled.description: Run T0 on every outgoing prompt. Code fences, inline code, paths, URLs, CONSTANTS and error lines are protected unconditionally.

aiBridge.compressor.tier.markdownDescription: `T0` is deterministic and free. `T1` adds an opt-in local model pass; `auto` uses T1 only when the memory gate allows it and a backend is reachable. T1 can never make a prompt worse: if it loses an identifier, damages a protected span or fails to shorten, T0 is used instead.

aiBridge.compressor.budgetTokens.description: If T0 alone leaves the prompt above this, one harder pass runs (articles and connectives dropped). It never escalates twice.

aiBridge.t1.mode.markdownDescription: §5.6: T1 auto-offs below 8 GB of RAM. `on` forces it (the user's explicit opt-in); `off` disables it everywhere.

aiBridge.t1.minRamGb.description: RAM threshold for the automatic T1 gate, in GB.

aiBridge.t1.backend.markdownDescription: `ollama` talks to a local model over HTTP (external RAM). `llamacpp` uses `node-llama-cpp` in-process (50–150 MB band) and needs `t1.modelPath`.

aiBridge.t1.modelPath.description: Path to a .gguf model for the llama.cpp backend.

aiBridge.t1.timeoutMs.description: T1 must answer within this window or the prompt goes out with T0 only.

aiBridge.rotation.enabled.description: On a detected provider limit, rotate to a fresh chat and carry the context across (spec §5.1).

aiBridge.rotation.preview.description: When to show the editable boot document before injecting.

aiBridge.router.failover.description: On a provider limit, move to the next provider in priority order and inject the boot so the context follows (§5.9).

aiBridge.features.commit.enabled.description: Show the sparkle button in Source Control to write a commit message.

aiBridge.features.commit.model.markdownDescription: Model for commit messages. `auto` prefers a free model, so the strong one is left for chat.

aiBridge.features.commit.style.description: The commit message style to ask for.

aiBridge.features.commit.extra.description: Extra instruction appended to the commit prompt, e.g. mention the ticket number.

aiBridge.features.suggestions.model.markdownDescription: Model for inline suggestions (batch 8.3b). `auto` prefers a free model.

aiBridge.features.fix.model.markdownDescription: Model for quick fixes (batch 8.3b). `auto` prefers a free model.

aiBridge.features.suggestions.enabled.description: Enable on-demand ghost-text suggestions. Never fires while typing.

aiBridge.features.suggestions.maxPrefixC.description: Characters of code before the cursor sent to the model.

aiBridge.features.suggestions.maxSuffixC.description: Characters of code after the cursor sent to the model.

aiBridge.features.fix.enabled.description: Show 'AI Bridge: Fix this' in the Quick Fix menu on errors and warnings.
